note: Guards are hard: a candidate failing any of them has no score. Positive paired deltas are candidate minus baseline. Each guard records where it came from so a user verdict is traceable to the metric it became. Generated town and trench maps (town-*, trench-*) are symmetric battles and carry guards only, like the authored maps, until a mixed-controller sparring battle exists.
